selection_rule: Precommitted P11 public task selection: next four previously unexposed train scenarios in sorted ID order, variant _1; never replace based on outcomes.
server_lease_basis: Identical server command restarted after P10 complete and empty model slot; bounded --max-seconds14400. Per-trial evaluation180sec plus180sec reserve, no start below8100sec remaining.
scope: Four selected development scenarios, one seed each, fixed P10 full-history baseline. No memory-method comparison or confirmatory claim.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: Same model, prompt, discovery, history renderer and per-trial limits as P10.
Native roles chosen for standard explicit action/result correspondence after both development tasks passed; P8 was cheaper in logical tokens, and is not suppressed.
API-boundary DB/harness capture is offline-only; its time, failure and bytes are recorded. No Python/RNG/process restoration claim.
All four preselected scenarios remain; independent evaluation stays offline and never feeds later generation.
This finite additional baseline is followed by same-interface memory comparisons, not repeated baseline tuning.
history_representation: Append-only public assistant content/calls and tool observations; no reasoning replay. Same archive page size. Invalid argument turns use text fallback preserving raw calls and actual results.
